title: Thirty Years at the Corner Shop

pre.en: What did the street do for Mr Patel last Sunday?
pre.zh: 上周日，街坊们为 Patel 先生做了什么？
options: They closed the shop and took him to the seaside.
They bought him a new phone.
They worked in the shop so he could rest.
They had a party for him in the shop.

intro: 一篇人物小传，写「我」住的那条街上开街角小店的 Patel 先生。读的时候留意 have to、don't have to、must、mustn't：哪些事他必须做，哪些事他明明不必做却天天在做，还有他太太给他定的规矩。

sentences.en: When I moved in, Mr Patel was the first neighbour to learn my name.
sentences.zh: 我刚搬来那会儿，街坊里头一个记住我名字的，就是 Patel 先生。

sentences.en: He's run the corner shop on our street since 1996.
sentences.zh: 从 1996 年起，他就在我们这条街上开街角小店。

sentences.en: And he knows everyone's shopping list by heart.
sentences.zh: 谁家平时买什么，他都记得清清楚楚。

sentences.en: "Running a shop is easy," he says with a grin.
sentences.zh: 「开店很简单，」他咧嘴一笑，

sentences.en: "You just have to be there."
sentences.zh: 「人一直在就行。」

sentences.en: And he always is.
sentences.zh: 他也真的一直都在。

sentences.en: He gets up at five and stocks the shelves on his own.
sentences.zh: 他每天五点起床，一个人把货架摆满。

sentences.en: The shop doesn't have to open on Sundays, but it always does.
sentences.zh: 周日本来可以不开门，可这家店每个周日都照开。

sentences.en: Actually, until last Sunday, he hadn't taken a day off for ten years.
sentences.zh: 说起来，直到上周日之前，他已经整整十年没休过一天假了。

sentences.en: He's looked after children whose parents were running late.
sentences.zh: 有的家长来晚了，他就帮忙看孩子。

sentences.en: He keeps spare keys for half the street, too.
sentences.zh: 半条街的备用钥匙也都放在他那儿。

sentences.en: If you forget your wallet, you don't have to pay straight away.
sentences.zh: 忘带钱包也没关系，钱可以回头再给。

sentences.en: He gives away any fruit that's starting to go off.
sentences.zh: 快放坏的水果，他都送人。

sentences.en: Even when there's a queue, he's got plenty of time for a chat.
sentences.zh: 就算有人排队，他也总有工夫跟你聊上几句。

sentences.en: So everyone knows they can count on him.
sentences.zh: 所以大家都知道，有事找他准没错。

sentences.en: The shop means a lot to the street, and the street means a lot to him.
sentences.zh: 这家店对这条街很重要，这条街对他也一样。

sentences.en: Families who've moved away still keep in touch.
sentences.zh: 搬走的人家，到现在还跟他有联系。

sentences.en: He always looks forward to their postcards.
sentences.zh: 他总盼着他们寄来的明信片。

sentences.en: And kids who used to buy sweets from him now bring their own kids.
sentences.zh: 当年在他这儿买糖的小孩，现在都带着自己的孩子来了。

sentences.en: Anyway, last Sunday the whole street closed the shop and took him to the seaside.
sentences.zh: 总之，上周日，整条街的人把店一关，拉着他去了海边。

sentences.en: It was his wife's idea, and she made two rules.
sentences.zh: 这是他太太出的主意，她还定了两条规矩。

sentences.en: "You must leave your phone at home, and you mustn't talk about the shop."
sentences.zh: 「手机必须留在家里，而且不许提店里的事。」

sentences.en: Well, he left his phone at home.
sentences.zh: 嗯，手机他倒是留在家里了。

sentences.en: Then he spent the whole day asking who was looking after the shop.
sentences.zh: 然后一整天都在问：店里谁看着呢？

cards.note: to start living in a new home
英国街区里卖日用品、零食和报纸的小店，开得早、关得晚，常常也是街坊的消息中心。
from memory, without needing to read it
to own or manage a shop and be responsible for it
cards.tip: run 在这里是「经营、管理」：run a café、run a team 都这么说。open a shop 只是「开张」那一下，说长期经营要用 run。
cards.example: My aunt runs a small flower shop near the station.

cards.note: 名词 stock 是「库存」：in stock 有货，out of stock 缺货。
alone, or without help from anyone
cards.tip: your 要跟着主语变：on my own、on his own、on our own；意思和 by yourself 一样。
cards.example: I fixed the bug on my own in the end.

cards.note: to have a day away from work
cards.tip: off 是「不上班」：休一下午是 take the afternoon off，泛说「请假」用 take time off。
cards.example: I'm taking a day off on Friday to help my parents move.

cards.note: to take care of someone or something and keep them safe and well
cards.tip: 英式英语里很常用，和 take care of 意思接近；后面直接接人或东西，不加 for。
cards.example: My neighbour looks after my cat when I'm travelling for work.

cards.note: to be later than you planned
spare keys 备用钥匙；spare time 空闲时间；spare room 客房。
英式英语里，女士用的长款钱包常叫 purse。
to give something to someone for free
(of food) to become bad and no longer good to eat
a lot of; more than enough
cards.tip: 可数、不可数名词都能接：plenty of time、plenty of ideas；多用在肯定句里。
cards.example: Don't rush — we have plenty of time before the demo.

cards.note: to trust someone to help you or to do what they have promised
cards.tip: 常见句型 count on sb to do sth；意思相近的还有 rely on、depend on。
cards.example: You can count on me to finish the report by Friday.

cards.note: to be very important to someone
cards.tip: 主语是那件重要的事或那个人：It means a lot to me. 不说 I mean a lot to it。表示感谢也常说 That means a lot.
cards.example: Your message after the launch meant a lot to the whole team.

cards.note: to continue to talk or write to someone
cards.tip: 跟某人保持联系用 with：keep in touch with old classmates；「断了联系」是 lose touch。
cards.example: Let's keep in touch after the project ends.

cards.note: to feel happy about something that is going to happen
cards.tip: to 是介词，后面接名词或 doing：look forward to hearing from you，不说 look forward to hear。
cards.example: I'm looking forward to the team dinner on Friday.

cards.note: 英式说 sweets，美式说 candy。
go to the seaside 是英国人常说的「去海边玩一天」，比 the beach 更有出游的味道。
